description: First-boot provisioning for the native Linux shape -- the native apt case. Start from the minimal Ubuntu 24.04.4 base rootfs this shape ships and install the remaining OS pieces (kernel image, systemd, GRUB, initramfs) plus a lean desktop on first boot, pinned to a dated snapshot mirror for a reproducible boot. This is the first-boot variant of the chroot apt-install documented in linux/BUILD.md; use it for a small base + fast per-user provisioning.

packages.name: linux-image-generic
packages.reason: Ubuntu kernel image + modules for the installed system.

firstBoot: echo 'Linux shape provisioned via apt on first boot.'
